product.title: Break & Build Kit — Axe + Wrench Bundle
product.body_html:
Demolish what fails. Rebuild what works.

The brute-force pairing for emergency rescue, vehicle extraction, and post-disaster scenarios. When you need to break and repair — this is the carry that does both.

What's included

  • 1 × Desert Breacher — Multi-function tactical axe (vehicle breach, wood splitting, hammer, built-in 7.2cm folding knife)
  • 1 × Roadside Fix — Multi-function tactical wrench (8mm-19mm hex, plier, wire cutter, built-in 7.5cm folding knife)
  • 1 × MOLLE Sheath + 1 × Belt Pouch
  • 1 × Survival72 Quick-Reference Card

Why this combo

Disaster recovery follows two phases: extraction (breaking through obstacles, accessing trapped persons or supplies) and stabilization (re-securing structures, fixing damaged equipment). This kit is built for the first 72 hours when both capabilities matter most.

Specifications

Total Weight805 g
Combined Materials3CR13 hardened steel (both axe and wrench, black phosphate finish)
Total Folding Knife Blades2 (7.2 cm in axe + 7.5 cm in wrench)
PackagingStandard cardboard box

Save $29 vs buying separately

Bundle price: $79 (vs $91 if bought as individual items). Free shipping on orders over $35.

Shipping & Returns

Cash on Delivery available across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman. 30-day return window from delivery date.
